# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_settings_doc.py from inventree_xero/core.py - do not edit by hand. -->

All settings are on the plugin's settings page in InvenTree (Admin Center → Plugins → Xero). Defaults are the safe choice unless noted.

## Safety (read these first)

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Write mode | `WRITE_MODE` | Dry run (nothing written) | Dry run: work out and log everything that would be sent, write nothing. Live: write to Xero. Paused: the kill switch - nothing is sent or changed. Options: Dry run (nothing written); Live; Paused (kill switch). |
| Let InvenTree approve documents | `AUTO_APPROVE` | no | Off (recommended): purchase orders, invoices and bills always go to Xero as Draft and a person approves them in Xero. On: the approve-when settings below take effect. |
| Allow delete / void | `ALLOW_DELETE_VOID` | no | Off (recommended): cancelling in InvenTree never deletes or voids a Xero document - it is held for you to deal with in Xero. |
| Import new Xero documents | `IMPORT_NEW_DOCUMENTS` | no | Create InvenTree orders from purchase orders / invoices / quotes entered in Xero. Off: only the status of linked documents comes back from Xero. |
| Contact matching | `CONTACT_MATCH` | Strict (recommended) | Strict: link automatically only on an exact name with no conflicting email or ABN; anything uncertain (duplicates, near-matches) is held for you to link by hand. Options: Strict (recommended); Exact name only. |
| Require tax types | `REQUIRE_TAX_TYPE` | yes | Hold documents until the purchase and sales tax types are set (so GST is never guessed) |
| Check totals | `CHECK_TOTALS` | yes | Hold a document when its Xero lines don't add up to the InvenTree order total. |
| Allow lines with no price | `ALLOW_ZERO_PRICE` | no | Off: a document with any unpriced line is held. |
| Alert emails | `ALERT_EMAILS` | (blank) | Who is emailed about errors and held documents (comma-separated). Blank = superusers. |
| Audit retention (days) | `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | `365` | How long the record of every write to Xero is kept. |

## Connection

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Connection type | `AUTH_MODE` | OAuth 2.0 web app | Standard OAuth app (Connect button) or a Xero Custom Connection (machine-to-machine) Options: OAuth 2.0 web app; Custom Connection. |
| Client ID | `CLIENT_ID` | (blank) | From your app at developer.xero.com → My Apps. |
| Client secret | `CLIENT_SECRET` | (blank) | From your app at developer.xero.com → My Apps. (Stored protected.) |
| OAuth scopes | `SCOPES` | (blank) | Blank (recommended): only the Xero permissions the features you switched on need. Reconnect after changing features that need more. |
| InvenTree public URL | `BASE_URL` | (blank) | Used for the OAuth redirect URI, e.g. https://inventree.example.com. |
| Xero organisation (tenant) ID | `TENANT_ID` | (blank) | Leave blank to use the first organisation authorised. |

## Schedule

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled sync | `ENABLE_SCHEDULED` | yes | Run the sync automatically in the background worker. |
| Sync interval (minutes) | `SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES` | `15` | How often the scheduled sync runs (minimum 5) |
| Push on status change | `PUSH_ON_STATUS_CHANGE` | yes | Send an order to Xero as soon as it is placed / issued / shipped / completed / cancelled. |

## Purchase orders

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase orders | `PO_SYNC_DIRECTION` | `both` | InvenTree purchase orders ↔ Xero purchase orders. |
| PO statuses to export | `PO_EXPORT_STATUSES` | `placed,on_hold,complete` | Comma-separated: pending, placed, on_hold, complete. |
| Xero status for placed POs | `PO_PLACED_XERO_STATUS` | Approved | Status for the Xero PO once the InvenTree PO is placed (only with "Let InvenTree approve") Options: Draft; Awaiting approval; Approved. |
| Use InvenTree PO number in Xero | `PO_USE_INVENTREE_REFERENCE` | yes | Set the Xero purchase order number to the InvenTree reference. |
| Xero PO statuses to import | `PO_IMPORT_STATUSES` | `SUBMITTED,AUTHORISED` | New Xero POs in these statuses are created in InvenTree (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED, BILLED) |

## Bills

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Create bills | `BILLS_MODE` | Off | Create a Xero bill (accounts payable) from received purchase order lines. Options: Off; As stock is received (draft bill kept up to date); When the purchase order is completed. |
| Bill status when PO complete | `BILL_STATUS` | Draft | Only with "Let InvenTree approve". Draft lets you add the supplier invoice no. and freight first. Options: Draft; Awaiting approval; Approved. |
| Bill due days | `BILL_DUE_DAYS` | `30` | Bill due date = bill date + this many days. |
| Mark Xero PO as billed | `MARK_PO_BILLED` | yes | When the PO is complete and its bill exists, set the Xero purchase order to Billed. |
| Link bills entered in Xero | `LINK_XERO_BILLS` | yes | Link a bill created in Xero to the InvenTree PO whose number appears in its reference. |

## Sales

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sales orders | `SO_SYNC_DIRECTION` | `both` | InvenTree sales orders ↔ Xero sales invoices or quotes. |
| Xero document for sales orders | `SO_XERO_DOCUMENT` | Sales invoice | Xero has no sales orders - use sales invoices or quotes (web shop orders are always invoices) Options: Sales invoice; Quote. |
| SO statuses to export | `SO_EXPORT_STATUSES` | `in_progress,shipped,complete` | Comma-separated: pending, in_progress, on_hold, shipped, complete. |
| Approve invoice when | `SO_AUTHORISE_ON` | Never (approve in Xero) | Only with "Let InvenTree approve": invoices stay Draft until the order reaches this stage. Options: Never (approve in Xero); Order issued; Order shipped; Order complete. |
| Invoice due days | `SO_DUE_DAYS` | `30` | Due date when the sales order has no target date. |
| Use InvenTree SO number in Xero | `SO_USE_INVENTREE_REFERENCE` | no | Use the SO reference as the invoice/quote number (off: Xero numbering, SO ref in Reference) |
| Xero invoice statuses to import | `INVOICE_IMPORT_STATUSES` | `AUTHORISED,PAID` | New Xero sales invoices in these statuses become InvenTree sales orders. |
| Xero quote statuses to import | `QUOTE_IMPORT_STATUSES` | `ACCEPTED` | New Xero quotes in these statuses become InvenTree sales orders (quote mode) |
| Issue imported sales orders | `SO_ISSUE_ON_IMPORT` | yes | Issue the InvenTree SO when its Xero invoice is approved / quote accepted. |

## What inventree holds

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Xero lines that are not parts | `NON_PART_LINES` | Keep in Xero only (InvenTree holds parts only) | Labour, freight, interest etc. on Xero documents. Options: Keep in Xero only (InvenTree holds parts only); Also import as InvenTree extra lines. |
| Skip Xero documents without parts | `IMPORT_SKIP_NO_PARTS` | yes | Do not create InvenTree orders for Xero documents with no part lines (labour, interest...) |
| Update lines from Xero | `IMPORT_UPDATE_LINES` | yes | Refresh part lines of Xero-originated orders that are still pending in InvenTree. |

## Contacts

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Contacts | `CONTACT_SYNC` | Link, or create when missing | How suppliers and customers are linked to Xero contacts. Options: Link existing contacts only; Link, or create when missing; Link or create, and push InvenTree detail changes. |
| Create InvenTree companies | `AUTO_CREATE_COMPANIES` | yes | Create a supplier/customer when an imported Xero contact has no match. |
| Import account balances | `BALANCE_SYNC` | yes | Store each linked company's outstanding/overdue Xero balance (used for shop credit checks) |
| Balance refresh (minutes) | `BALANCE_INTERVAL_MINUTES` | `60` | How often balances are refreshed (minimum 15) |
| Balance parameter | `BALANCE_PARAMETER` | `Xero Outstanding` | Also write the customer's outstanding balance to this company parameter (blank = off) |

## Items

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Xero item code from | `ITEM_CODE_SOURCE` | Part name | Which InvenTree field matches the Xero Item code (max 30 characters) Options: Part name; Part IPN; Supplier SKU (purchase lines). |
| Create Xero items | `CREATE_XERO_ITEMS` | no | Create missing Xero Items for exported lines (off: lines are sent without an item code) |
| Create supplier parts on import | `AUTO_CREATE_SUPPLIER_PARTS` | no | Link an imported PO line to a part by creating the missing supplier part. |

## Web shop

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Web shop integration | `SHOP_INTEGRATION` | yes | With the inventree-woocommerce plugin: invoice web orders as soon as they arrive. |
| Approve paid web order invoices | `SHOP_AUTHORISE_PAID` | yes | Only with "Let InvenTree approve": web orders paid online get an approved invoice straight away. |
| Xero document for web orders | `SHOP_ORDER_DOCUMENT` | Sales invoice | Paid / charged-to-account web orders are sales, so normally invoices. Options: Sales invoice; Same as "Xero document for sales orders". |
| Web shop quote requests | `SHOP_QUOTES` | Price and send in Xero (Xero is the quote) | Price in Xero: each request becomes a draft Xero quote; price it there (parts, labour, freight - any line), mark it Sent and the shop sends the customer Xero's PDF. The shop's own pricing is locked meanwhile (back to InvenTree pricing in a dry run or if disconnected). The other choices price in InvenTree and copy the quote to Xero. Options: Price and send in Xero (Xero is the quote); Priced in InvenTree, draft in Xero as soon as a request arrives; Priced in InvenTree, into Xero once it is sent to the customer; Off. |
| Xero quote edits go to the shop | `SHOP_QUOTE_XERO_EDITS` | yes | Only when priced in InvenTree (always on with "Price and send in Xero"): line changes in Xero update the shop quote; marking it Sent sends it to the customer; Draft reopens it; Declined declines it (Summary = reason) |
| Customers can accept part of a Xero quote | `SHOP_QUOTE_PARTIAL_ACCEPT` | no | Only with "Price and send in Xero". Off (recommended): customers accept the whole quote, so the order always matches the Xero quote. |
| Re-send revised quotes automatically | `SHOP_QUOTE_AUTO_RESEND` | no | Off (recommended): a sent quote you revise in Xero goes back to Draft; marking it Sent again is what sends the revision to the customer. |
| Default decline reason | `SHOP_QUOTE_DECLINE_REASON` | (blank) | Sent to the customer when a quote is declined in Xero without a Summary (blank = require one) |
| Web shop payment account | `SHOP_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT` | (blank) | Only with "Let InvenTree approve". Xero account to record online payments against (blank = off, recommended - let your Stripe/bank feed reconcile payments) |

## Accounting

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase account code | `PURCHASE_ACCOUNT_CODE` | `300` | Xero account for purchase order and bill lines. |
| Purchase tax type | `PURCHASE_TAX_TYPE` | (blank) | Xero tax type for purchase lines, e.g. INPUT (AU GST on expenses). Blank = account default. |
| Sales account code | `SALES_ACCOUNT_CODE` | `200` | Xero account for invoice and quote lines. |
| Sales tax type | `SALES_TAX_TYPE` | (blank) | Xero tax type for sales lines, e.g. OUTPUT (AU GST on income). Blank = account default. |
| Prices are | `LINE_AMOUNT_TYPES` | Tax exclusive | How InvenTree line prices relate to tax. Options: Tax exclusive; Tax inclusive; No tax. |
| Send order currency | `SEND_CURRENCY` | no | Send the order currency (needs Xero multi-currency). Off = Xero base currency. |

## Housekeeping

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| First import look-back (days) | `IMPORT_SINCE_DAYS` | `30` | On the first run, import Xero documents modified in this many days. |
| Export look-back (days) | `EXPORT_LOOKBACK_DAYS` | `180` | Only orders created within this many days are exported (linked orders always sync) |
| Set order link | `SET_ORDER_LINK` | yes | Put the Xero document URL in the order Link field (if empty) |
| Tag description with Xero number | `TAG_DESCRIPTION` | yes | Append [Xero INV-0001] to the order description so InvenTree search finds it. |
| Log retention (days) | `LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` | `60` | Sync log entries older than this are deleted. |
